architecture: clean-room OaF-style CNN plus bidirectional LSTM

training.note: The retained best snapshot is the validation-recalibrated resume state; later focal-loss epochs did not exceed its validation macro F1.

limitations: The validation data contains isolated drum performances rather than arbitrary mastered songs.
Low tom and tambourine have overlays but no natural validation support.
This checkpoint is only one component of the non-commercial v19 research decoder.
